title.en: An ordinary event can make an absence noticeable
title.zh: 普通事情也会让缺席变得鲜明

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的沅四条依次选有时、较常、未计分、没有注意到，另一个人对调前两条，六类计数仍相同，但注意到的是不同描述。这不是同样深浅的爱或哀伤。沅选择不足三个月作为可选背景，换成不愿回答也不改变这四条计数或五篇全文；回想只覆盖离世后的日子，不把发生前也算入。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Yuan selects sometimes, often, unscored and did not notice. Another person swaps the first two, leaving identical counts attached to different descriptions. Neither record measures the depth of love or grief. Yuan chooses less than three months as optional context; withholding timing leaves all counts and five guides unchanged. Recall includes only days after the death.

title.en: Choose what, if anything, you want to share
title.zh: 分享多少，或是否分享，由你选择

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“同样的类别数量为什么不能比较关系的重要程度？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不评判谁哀伤得对、不要求本人故事，也不把讨论变成应完成的哀伤任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “Why can identical category counts not compare the importance of relationships?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without personal stories, judging whose grief is right or making discussion a required grief task.

title.en: Keep a description separate from a measure of recovery
title.zh: 描述不同于恢复程度测量

paragraphs.zh: 16条为费马原创成人观察，不施测已发表哀伤量表、诊断标准或阶段算法。回顾离世之后的过去四周；若离世更近，只看发生之后的日子。五个阅读主题依次4、3、3、3、3条，各条选择没有注意到、很少、有时、较常、经常或未计分；标识0至4是类别ID，不是点数、精确天数或事件次数。每主题六类计数合计自身条数，16条所选标签保留；未计分可指没有经历、无法回想或不愿回答，网页不区分原因，不补成没有注意到。16条各选一个给定类别即可整理，全部未计分也能完成，不推断没有困难；不加总、平均、排名或分配最高主题。时间默认不愿回答，可选不足三个月、三至二十四个月、超过二十四个月、无法判断或不愿回答；只是方便提供背景，不计入观察、不改变计数、正文或支持条件。时间不是临床界线、哀伤阶段或康复日程。尚无常模、阈值、验证或中英文测量等值；之后类别不同不证明恢复、恶化或活动效果。NHS及APA资料只作支持与独立临床评估背景，不验证原创题目或编辑虚构情境，不把此页变成延长哀伤评估。爱、忠诚、身份、依恋、关系安全或需要何种治疗，都不由类别决定。五篇七节全文和支持说明答题前后始终开放，退出或保留时间也可读；可选讨论只用虚构信息，不要求本人记录、离世经过、照片、遗物、重访、联系、和解或完成活动。答案、整理记录及可选时间仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址。完成时清除作答状态；退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录与时间，重新开始不恢复。复制仅含公开标题及入口，不含回答、计数或时间；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或他人已看到的信息。可以不完成就询问合适专业人士或丧失支持服务；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不等待时间点、计数或完成此页。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult observations administer no published grief scale, diagnostic criteria or stage algorithm. Recall the past four weeks after the death; if more recent, consider only days since it happened. Five reading topics contain four, three, three, three and three statements. Each receives did not notice, rarely, sometimes, often, very often or unscored. IDs zero through four are category identifiers, not points, exact days or event counts. Six counts sum to each theme’s size, with all 16 selected labels retained. Unscored can mean no experience, unclear recall or withholding without distinguishing the reason or replacing it with did not notice. Every observation needs an offered category to organize a record. All-unscored can finish without implying an absence of difficulty. No totals, averages, rankings or highest theme are assigned. Optional timing defaults to prefer not to answer; choices are less than three months, three to twenty-four months, more than twenty-four months, cannot place timing or prefer not to answer. This convenience context changes no count, public text or support access. It is no clinical cutoff, stage or recovery timetable. No norms, thresholds, validation or English–Chinese equivalence are established; changed categories prove no recovery, deterioration or activity effect. NHS and APA supply background about support and separate clinical assessment, not validation of these observations or fictional scenes, and do not turn this page into a prolonged-grief assessment. Categories decide no love, loyalty, identity, attachment, relationship safety or treatment need. All five seven-section guides and support information remain public before and after answers, including leaving midway or withholding timing. Optional discussion uses fiction without records, death narratives, photographs, belongings, revisiting, contact, reconciliation or completed activities. Answers, records and timing stay in page memory without drafts, submission, questionnaire analytics or personal-result addresses. Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record and timing without restoration. Copying contains only the public title and entry, not answers, counts or timing. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. You can ask an appropriate professional or bereavement service without finishing. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance without waiting for a time point, count or completion.

title.en: An ordinary question can reveal a change
title.zh: 普通问题也可能让变化显现

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的知三条分别选较常、未计分、没有注意到；临选没有注意到、未计分、较常。两人都有一条较常，却分别涉及关系中的角色与向别人描述生活的位置，不是同一身份变化。两人都无需按离世多久改称呼，也不因保留一条就让别人代填、推断否认或决定该承担什么责任。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Zhi selects often, unscored and did not notice; Lin selects did not notice, unscored and often. Their single often response concerns different descriptions: a relational role versus explaining their place in life. Neither is an identity verdict. Timing sets no deadline to change a description, and an unscored item licenses no proxy answer, inference of denial or assignment of responsibilities.

title.en: A practical responsibility may need a practical question
title.zh: 现实责任可能需要现实问题

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样在不指定新身份的情况下读回一条角色观察？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不评判谁哀伤得对、不要求本人故事，也不把讨论变成应完成的哀伤任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a role observation be read without assigning a new identity?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without personal stories, judging whose grief is right or making discussion a required grief task.

title.en: A message can arrive at an unwanted moment
title.zh: 消息可能在不愿承受的时刻出现

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的芮三条依次选较常、未计分、没有注意到：曾暂放消息，没有相关到访经历，未注意到转开话题。希也有一次未计分，却是想保留回答；网页不区分两种未计分的原因，不能说二人都从未遇到提醒。这里不邀请打开消息、到访地点或讲述往事来补足资料，也不把保持距离判为不健康。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Rui selects often, unscored and did not notice: putting a message aside, having no relevant visit, and not noticing a subject change. Xi also leaves one item unscored but withholds it. The page cannot distinguish those unscored reasons or infer that neither encountered reminders. No opening messages, visiting places or recounting memories is needed to fill gaps, and distance receives no unhealthy label.

title.en: A conversation can have a limit

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样区分没有相关机会、未计分及没有注意到，而不要求接触提醒材料？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不评判谁哀伤得对、不要求本人故事，也不把讨论变成应完成的哀伤任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can missing opportunity, unscored and did not notice be distinguished without approaching reminders?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without personal stories, judging whose grief is right or making discussion a required grief task.

title.en: An invitation may involve more than the activity itself
title.zh: 邀请可能不只涉及活动本身

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的樾三条选有时、有时、未计分，关于想象计划与暂放活动各有一条有时，不是两天、两次或一个恢复分数。樾选择超过二十四个月；另一个人选择不足三个月，同样回答仍有同样计数。月数不规定参加邀请、享受活动或制订计划的期限，也不要求通过完成活动证明进展。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Yue selects sometimes, sometimes and unscored. Two sometimes labels concern imagining a plan and pausing an activity, not two days, two events or a recovery score. Yue selects more than twenty-four months. The same answers with less than three months give the same counts. Months set no deadline to attend, enjoy an activity or make plans, and completing an activity is no required proof of progress.

title.en: A practical question can stay small
title.zh: 实际问题可以保持很小

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样谈一个具体活动问题，而不把月数变成恢复期限？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不评判谁哀伤得对、不要求本人故事，也不把讨论变成应完成的哀伤任务。

Completing clears answer state; exit, retake, reload and leaving clear the record and timing without restoration. Copying contains only the public title and entry, not answers, counts or timing. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or information already seen. You can ask an appropriate professional or bereavement service without finishing. Immediate danger or inability to stay safe calls for local emergency assistance without waiting for a time point, count or completion.

title.en: An expected feeling may not arrive in an expected way
title.zh: 期待的感受未必按期待方式出现

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的翎三条选有时、经常、未计分，分别保留平淡或疏离、表达安慰需要的困难与不愿回答。祈在外表上很平静，网页没有其回答，不能替祈填没有注意到。可见表情、类别与关系重要程度是不同信息；两人都无需制造情绪、增加亲近或披露经历来证明在乎，也不从记录断定别人安全可靠。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Ling selects sometimes, very often and unscored, retaining separate descriptions of a flat or distant feeling, difficulty expressing a need for comfort, and withholding. Qi looks calm but has supplied no answers; no one can fill in did not notice for Qi. Expression, categories and a relationship’s importance are different information. Neither must create emotion, increase closeness or disclose experiences to prove care, and a record certifies no one’s safety or trustworthiness.

title.en: Comfort can be a small, specific request
title.zh: 安慰可以是小而具体的请求

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样让陪伴请求与情绪表达、私人经历披露分别保留选择？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，区分已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、保留回答或结束，不评判谁哀伤得对、不要求本人故事，也不把讨论变成应完成的哀伤任务。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a request for company preserve separate choices about emotional expression and private disclosure?” Use only the fictional people and information above to distinguish what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, withholding or stopping is allowed without personal stories, judging whose grief is right or making discussion a required grief task.

title.en: Keep a private observation without an emotional label
title.zh: 保留私人观察，不分配情绪标签

paragraphs.zh: 16条为费马原创成人观察，不施测已发表哀伤量表、诊断标准或阶段算法。回顾离世之后的过去四周；若离世更近，只看发生之后的日子。五个阅读主题依次4、3、3、3、3条，各条选择没有注意到、很少、有时、较常、经常或未计分；标识0至4是类别ID，不是点数、精确天数或事件次数。每主题六类计数合计自身条数，16条所选标签保留；未计分可指没有经历、无法回想或不愿回答，网页不区分原因，不补成没有注意到。16条各选一个给定类别即可整理，全部未计分也能完成，不推断没有困难；不加总、平均、排名或分配最高主题。时间默认不愿回答，可选不足三个月、三至二十四个月、超过二十四个月、无法判断或不愿回答；只是方便提供背景，不计入观察、不改变计数、正文或支持条件。时间不是临床界线、哀伤阶段或康复日程。尚无常模、阈值、验证或中英文测量等值；之后类别不同不证明恢复、恶化或活动效果。NHS及APA资料只作支持与独立临床评估背景，不验证原创题目或编辑虚构情境，不把此页变成延长哀伤评估。爱、忠诚、身份、依恋、关系安全或需要何种治疗，都不由类别决定。五篇七节全文和支持说明答题前后始终开放，退出或保留时间也可读；可选讨论只用虚构信息，不要求本人记录、离世经过、照片、遗物、重访、联系、和解或完成活动。答案、整理记录及可选时间仅留本页内存，无草稿、提交、问卷分析或个人结果地址。完成时清除作答状态；退出、重做、刷新、离页清除记录与时间，重新开始不恢复。复制仅含公开标题及入口，不含回答、计数或时间；清除不抹掉截图、浏览器记录或他人已看到的信息。可以不完成就询问合适专业人士或丧失支持服务；有即时危险或无法保障安全时寻求当地紧急援助，不等待时间点、计数或完成此页。
paragraphs.en: These 16 original adult observations administer no published grief scale, diagnostic criteria or stage algorithm. Recall the past four weeks after the death; if more recent, consider only days since it happened. Five reading topics contain four, three, three, three and three statements. Each receives did not notice, rarely, sometimes, often, very often or unscored. IDs zero through four are category identifiers, not points, exact days or event counts. Six counts sum to each theme’s size, with all 16 selected labels retained. Unscored can mean no experience, unclear recall or withholding without distinguishing the reason or replacing it with did not notice. Every observation needs an offered category to organize a record. All-unscored can finish without implying an absence of difficulty. No totals, averages, rankings or highest theme are assigned. Optional timing defaults to prefer not to answer; choices are less than three months, three to twenty-four months, more than twenty-four months, cannot place timing or prefer not to answer. This convenience context changes no count, public text or support access. It is no clinical cutoff, stage or recovery timetable. No norms, thresholds, validation or English–Chinese equivalence are established; changed categories prove no recovery, deterioration or activity effect. NHS and APA supply background about support and separate clinical assessment, not validation of these observations or fictional scenes, and do not turn this page into a prolonged-grief assessment. Categories decide no love, loyalty, identity, attachment, relationship safety or treatment need. All five seven-section guides and support information remain public before and after answers, including leaving midway or withholding timing.
